feature: Deck stats, PRs 1-2: the switch, the placement shell and the curve card
note: Needs DECK_STATS_ENABLED=true on the server and STATS_DECK (a deck with at least one creature and one other non-land card, so pressing Creature shows both lit and dimmed squares). The list toolbar shows the Stats segment beside All and Shopping; the stats row presses it and shows six empty shells with the list tools hidden. The curve card draws data; the other five figures stay empty shells until their PRs.
